claims.evidence: The report only shows the sewing machine, pedal, and power cord; no running/stitching test, motor sound, or sample stitching is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model not fully readable; wrong identification can lead to mismatched parts/expectations and affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate/label on the machine body (straight-on, readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified sewing machine with unknown brand/model (worst-case parts compatibility risk).

risks.risk: Function not proven (may not sew smoothly, may skip stitches, or pedal/motor may be weak).
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running with the pedal, plus a 30–60 second stitching test on at least two fabric types (e.g., cotton and denim) showing consistent stitches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / possibly needing service (worst-case non-working or poor performance).

risks.risk: Missing or worn accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides) can make the machine unusable or require extra spending.
risks.proof: A photo laid out of all included accessories: presser feet set, bobbins, needles, manual (if any), and any included tools.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case missing key parts).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition unknown (timing/feed mechanism, belt/drive, internal wear) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Video showing handwheel movement and feed motion while stitching, plus a close-up of the underside/belt/drive area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring inspection/possible servicing (worst-case internal wear).

risks.risk: Visible wear/damage not captured clearly (scratches, rust, cracks, missing knobs) could reduce value or indicate neglect.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the full machine body and table from multiple angles, including any seams, knobs, and the needle area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-wear used condition (worst-case hidden damage not ruled out).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the brand/model label so the exact model is readable.
Short video: power on + pedal test (motor response) and a stitching test showing even stitches.
Stitching test on two fabric thicknesses (e.g., cotton and denim) with a brief before/after of fabric feed.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides, tools/manual if any).
Close-up photos of the needle area and any visible wear points (knobs, seams, underside/table joints).
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as a sewing machine with pedal and power cord, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. The seller’s “works perfectly” claim is not supported by any running/stitching evidence in the report.
